spec.description: Single-page overview combining Production, Batch Costs, Gas Consumption and Temperature Monitoring.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(kf.created_at, '1h'),
    kf.kiln_id::text AS metric,
    ROUND(SUM(bc.total_energy_cost)::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM kiln_firing kf
JOIN firing_batch fb ON kf.firing_id = fb.firing_id
JOIN batch_cost bc ON fb.batch_id = bc.batch_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(kf.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT 
  bc.batch_id AS "Lote",
  bc.total_energy_cost AS "Custo Total (€)",
  bc.gas_consumed_m3 AS "Gás Consumido (m³)",
  bc.calculated_at AS "Data"
FROM batch_cost bc
WHERE bc.calculated_at >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY bc.calculated_at ASC;

SELECT 
    firing_duration_hours AS "Duração (h)",
    max_temp_recorded AS "Temperatura Máx (°C)",
    kiln_id AS "Forno"
FROM kiln_firing;

SELECT potter_name AS "Oleiro",
  ROUND((100.0 * SUM(broken_pieces) / NULLIF(SUM(total_qty),0))::numeric, 2) AS "Taxa de Defeito (%)"
FROM public.production
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT category AS "Categoria",
  ROUND((100.0 * SUM(broken_pieces) / NULLIF(SUM(total_qty),0))::numeric, 2) AS "Taxa de Defeito (%)"
FROM public.production
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Temperatura Máx vs Taxa de Defeito

spec.rawSql:
SELECT kf.max_temp_recorded::float AS temperatura,
  ROUND((100.0 * SUM(p.broken_pieces) / NULLIF(SUM(p.total_qty),0))::numeric, 2)::float AS taxa_defeito
FROM public.kiln_firing kf
JOIN public.firing_batch fb ON kf.firing_id = fb.firing_id
JOIN public.production p ON p.batch_id = fb.batch_id
GROUP BY kf.firing_id, kf.max_temp_recorded
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(kf.created_at, '1h'),
  kf.kiln_id::text AS metric,
  ROUND(SUM(bc.gas_consumed_m3)::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM public.kiln_firing kf
JOIN public.firing_batch fb ON kf.firing_id = fb.firing_id
JOIN public.batch_cost bc ON fb.batch_id = bc.batch_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(kf.created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT to_char(production_date::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Dia",
  SUM(total_qty) AS "Produzidas",
  SUM(broken_pieces) AS "Partidas/Rejeitadas"
FROM public.production
GROUP BY production_date::date
ORDER BY production_date::date DESC
LIMIT 14;

SELECT
    kf.kiln_id::text AS "Forno",
    ROUND(SUM(bc.total_energy_cost)::numeric, 2) AS "Custo Total (€)"
FROM kiln_firing kf
JOIN firing_batch fb ON kf.firing_id = fb.firing_id
JOIN batch_cost bc ON fb.batch_id = bc.batch_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(kf.created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    SUM(total_qty) AS "Peças Produzidas (hoje)",
    ROUND((SUM(total_qty) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - CURRENT_DATE::timestamptz)) / 3600, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Média Peças/Hora (hoje)",
    SUM(broken_pieces) AS "Peças Partidas/Rejeitadas (hoje)",
    ROUND((100.0 * SUM(broken_pieces) / NULLIF(SUM(total_qty), 0))::numeric, 2) AS "Taxa Média de Defeito (%)"
FROM public.production
WHERE production_date::date = CURRENT_DATE;
